popis:
We're holding our fourth camp for men again in Zvánovice / Struhařov, in the beautiful surroundings of the Říčany and Struhařov forests. We'll focus on drops, descents and root sections, as well as riding over rocks. Dealing with critical situations off-road. Riding down or dropping whatever nature puts in front of your wheels, brake control, steep climbs and lots of other tricks you'll find useful on the bike – all in one package.

LOCATION:

Struhařov and Zvánovice are a destination for many bikers, and the local forests and surroundings are full of surprises. There's practically everything you might encounter off the trails. We'll cover the basics of technique at the Master Horse Club grounds. The newly chosen venue is right next to rocky fields and several descents. On the way we'll come across rocks, fords, descents and climbs – all in the beautiful landscape of Josef Lada's country. For lunch we'll turn around at the Master Horse restaurant and head to the other side of the valley, where there's the option to ride some slightly sharper stuff.

MASTER HORSE CLUB grounds: Google Maps link

Venue website: https://www.masterhorseclub.cz/restaurace/

If you don't have a car, a transfer from Světice / Říčany train station can be arranged. The venue is also easy to reach on your own. Accommodation is available on site.

SUITABLE FOR:

Men, young boys and lads aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (ideally also men). Groups will be divided by ability. In terms of ability, it's suitable for anyone who's past easy trails and is looking for anything more technically demanding. Advanced riders and pros will find something here too – write to us and we'll happily advise whether the camp is right for you.

EQUIPMENT:

  • Mountain bike (MTB) or an e-bike with switchable assistance, in good technical condition.
  • Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.
  • We strongly recommend leaving clipless pedals at home and bringing ordinary flat pedals. If you let us know in advance, we'll happily lend you some on site and swap them ourselves.
  • Spare clothes.
  • We recommend gloves – ideally full-finger.
  • Insurance is up to each rider, but we recommend at least accident insurance.

WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:

  • Breakfast, lunch, snacks, fruit and drinks.
  • Equipment for minor servicing of your darlings (we mean bikes).
  • Obstacles for practising basic skills and small facilities.

SATURDAY – 17 September

07:30 – 08:00  Riders arrive, registration and equipment check with bike setup, with breakfast available

08:30 – 09:00  Introduction of instructors, information about the coaching and splitting into groups (if needed)

09:00 – 13:00 Technique training with the first ride

13:00 – 14:30 Workshop focused on the bike and equipment + lunch break, digestion and discussion (simply a chat)

14:30 – 18:00 Ride through more demanding training sections

18:30 – 19:30 Camp review, tips and so on …

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps have limited capacity. You can check availability in the header of the camp description (booked / total capacity), as well as the price. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property. Neither the organiser nor the instructors are responsible for rider injuries. GIVE A CAMP AS A GIFT AND USE OUR VOUCHERS, WHICH WE CAN ISSUE FOR AN AMOUNT OR A SPECIFIC CAMP. THEY CAN ALSO BE USED TO BUY GOODS IN OUR E-SHOP OR FOR INDIVIDUAL COURSES.
